creator: Alexander Terp
description: The app now asks an older daemon at its own socket to hand its panes to this build's daemon, local and remote. The local path has tests; the remote path (install this build's daemon over ssh first, then ask the older one) is covered only by a manual check. The --ssh tier could start an older-saying daemon in the devenv container (debug-only MUSTER_DAEMON_VERSION_SAID), attach, and expect a handoff with the panes' pids kept.
title: The ssh tier checks a remote daemon is handed over
